hypothesis: V99 sampled trajectories may obscure policy-level performance. Exact conditional expectation and a fixed argmax deployment separate sampling from distribution quality, without another actor fit.
sources: All six frozen V99 expanded actors, original ENTRY100 and twelve V97/V98 PREFIX200 per development context; full frozen V98 grid. No training or new image evaluation.
primary: FIXED_ARGMAX EXPANDED_RL compared with same readout CE/INIT, fixed training-global/time and UNIFORM exact expectation. Also original CONTINUE_CE and POOLED_RL sampled historical reference; all modes reported regardless result. Both seeds must improve utility over CE and INIT, mean utility >=.0005 over all controls, new>=+.002 with old>=-.0025 OR old>=+.005 with new>=-.0025 versus CE/INIT/uniform/CONTINUE_CE.
expectation: For each context and actor, p100(a)*p200(b|PREFIX_a) weights each of144cached trajectories. Normalize each float64 probability vector once to sum1. Sum each trajectory utility including its own retention hinge; never hinge the expected old score. Exact only conditional on this frozen student/data stream, not population or unseen stream.
argmax: Lowest action ID ties; first argmax p100, second argmax p200 conditional on that first action. No temperature search, no seed/arm selection or retraining. Uniform argmax action0 included as mechanical tie control; primary uniform comparison uses expectation.
barrier: Extract all52states and312actor probability vectors (4contexts x13states x6actors) before reading scores. All probabilities and24actorargmaxpairs plus12simplepairs sealed, then read frozen grid. Workers cannot access Qdev metric files or run scores.
qualification: Exact all72 saved V99 selected-state probability vectors and36action pairs including simple controls using original private categorical generator. Native state snapshot before/after extraction identical; zero native/actor updates and no query access. Positive/negative selfchecks: conditional expectation differs from independent action marginal, pointmass equals grid row, uniform equals gridmean, argmax tie rule.
controls_fairness: CE/RL fits remain matched V99 models. Readout modes are secondary development analyses, not new independent replications. Do not select a favorable readout and describe it as preregistered V99 performance.
limits: Repeated D1, same queries and simulated old. All prior failures remain. New methodological iteration permitted by user, but hidden U labels, real later domains or sealed test remain out of scope.
completion: Publish all distributions, mode-level and context/seed outcomes, receipts and costs through proxy GitHub and NAS. This finite diagnostic is not a hyperparameter search or new scientific confirmation.
